mutationSeams.reason: The state engine's forward migration steps. Table rebuilds and backfills run once per schema advance, inside the engine, before any repository can read. The 20 -> 21 consolidation step also rebuilds work_facts (rows copied forward byte-exact) to shed its FK into the retired blob generation store.
The state engine's own schema witness row.

Work-plane DDL. The only INSERTs are inside AFTER INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE triggers that bump the projection revision counter, so the write is SQLite's and local to the row, which is exactly why no call path can bypass it.

THE EVENT JOURNAL APPEND. SQLite is the factory world's append-only journal and this file is the only place a journal record is written: allocateSequence / rememberIncomingSequence number a route, appendWorkRecord writes the record envelope plus its command / fact / disposition variant, appendPendingCommand indexes a command as unresolved. It decides nothing — minting, authority, and materialization stay in repository.ts. The runtime half of the same law is work/mutation-seam.ts, which refuses a projection write that no append here explains.
mutationSeams.retire: The four record tables plus work_event_sequences are the destination shape and stay. work_pending_commands is the debt: it is a derived index of unresolved commands, so once the in-memory world holds that index it leaves this file's table set and the entry becomes permanent.

journalFreeMutations.reason: Two operator artifact operations mutate the projection and mint no fact: set_archived rewrites metadata_json in place, delete removes the row with no tombstone. Neither replicates, and a rebuild from the journal loses the archive flag and resurrects the deleted artifact.
journalFreeMutations.retire: Mint artifact.archive and artifact.retract facts and materialize them like every other operation, then delete both reasons from UNJOURNALED_WORK_REASONS.
